items.title: AI is turning Apple's app review process into a nightmare for synth developers
items.summary: The surge of AI and AI-generated apps is overwhelming Apple’s app review process, leaving developers caught in the crossfire – two examples!
items.titleZh: AI 正让苹果的应用审核流程成为合成器开发者的噩梦
items.summaryZh: AI 和 AI 生成应用激增，令苹果的应用审核流程不堪重负，开发者也因此受到波及——这里有两个例子！

items.title: Edge0-145B: Frontier AI Capabilities on Your Own Computer
items.summary: Meet Edge0-145B, an open-source 145B model for local coding, reasoning, and agent tasks, with no cloud-model token fees for local inference.
items.titleZh: Edge0-145B：在自己的电脑上体验前沿 AI 能力
items.summaryZh: Edge0-145B 是一款开源的 145B 模型，可在本地执行编程、推理和智能体任务，使用本地推理无需支付云端模型的 token 费用。

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cost-efficient model built for reliable agentic workflows and everyday tasks. Get the details.
items.summaryZh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen。这款模型速度快、成本效益高，专为可靠的智能体工作流和日常任务打造。了解详情。

items.title: Rust 1.100
items.summary: Empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.
items.summaryZh: 助力每个人构建可靠、高效的软件。

items.title: Show HN: My $300 embroidery machine needed a subscription, so I built my own app
items.summary: Free, open-source embroidery software for Mac and Windows. Turn SVG artwork into machine embroidery, edit stitches visually, and create designs with AI agents via MCP. - simpsoka/zigzag
items.titleZh: Show HN：我的 300 美元刺绣机需要订阅，我于是自己开发了应用
items.summaryZh: 适用于 Mac 和 Windows 的免费开源刺绣软件。将 SVG 图稿转换为机器刺绣图案、直观地编辑针迹，还可通过 MCP 使用 AI 智能体创建设计。- simpsoka/zigzag

items.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
items.summary: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.
items.titleZh: 民主党人启动对 Nvidia 的调查，致信严厉谴责黄仁勋与特朗普的“勾结”
items.summaryZh: 这是针对 Nvidia 对华销售及其与特朗普往来的国会调查；自所谓间谍丑闻曝光以来，这已是迄今为止的第二项调查。

items.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
items.summary: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.
items.titleZh: Muse 现在可以拨打电话给美国企业——但需要付费
items.summaryZh: Muse 的 AI 现在可以主动致电美国企业，但这项服务并非免费。

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.titleZh: 黄仁勋风波持续发酵：事件时间线
items.summaryZh: 黄仁勋在发生婚外情后已辞去 Nvidia 职务。随着美国和中国竞相开发最先进的 AI 基础设施，此事可能对国家安全产生影响。

items.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.summary: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.
items.titleZh: Nebius 计划投入 400 亿美元，试水新云计算发展模式
items.summaryZh: Nebius 计划通过客户预付款和贷款，为其 400 亿美元的 AI 基础设施扩张筹资；与此同时，微软数据中心项目的延期也让其融资模式受到质疑。

items.title: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports
items.summary: Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.

items.summaryZh: 路透社未披露与黄仁勋有关联的新员工姓名，但称她是 Nvidia 员工。

items.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
items.summary: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.
items.titleZh: Google 最新搜索升级，承诺更好地回答最复杂的问题
items.summaryZh: 在 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的驱动下，Google 的 AI 模式将更善于理解复杂查询、呈现相关链接，并提供更丰富的视觉化回答。

items.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
items.summary: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.
